card.name: Verbs of observing or reporting findings
card.fires_on: Verbs of witnessing or reporting, like seen, reported, observed, saw, noticing, occurring, when someone describes effects or trends they have observed. Mostly in news-style web text about health, wildlife or climate.

modes.label: Observation verbs
modes.description: A verb such as seen, reported, observed, saw or noticing after a person or group who witnesses an effect.
modes.example: said he has<< seen>> the devastating effects of vaccine-preventable

modes.label: Occurring now
modes.description: Words saying that impacts are occurring or happening now.
modes.example: impacts are occurring<< now>> and are expected to increase.
